paragraphs.text: Buxton is a legendary rabbitfolk noble from Bloomburrow .

The noble Buxton's home holds a cozy, warmly lit, rustic, circular room with arched windows and wooden beams. Buxton is a large, well-dressed rabbitfolk , who hosts a gathering of various animalfolk for a meal. His large, portly figure has a distinguished and regal air, and his rich, ornate clothing is heavily adorned with intricate patterns and medals, suggesting his status as an important figure. Buxton's table is lavishly set with a large vegetable dish at the center, a feast prepared for his guests, which include badgerfolk , ratfolk , mousefolk , and raccoonfolk , as well as other rabbitfolk, all dressed in formal or semi-formal attire. Some guests listen to Buxton as he speaks, although a few appear to have fallen asleep.
